import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s1 = np.sqrt(1+t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*P**3
            + p[4]*s1*np.sqrt(P) + p[5]*s1
            + p[6]*t*np.log(P) + p[7]*t*P*np.exp(-P)
            + p[8]*P*np.log(P) + p[9]*np.log(t)*P)
